title: Unified Static and Dynamic Network: Efficient Temporal Filtering for Video Grounding

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: Unified Static and Dynamic Network: Efficient Temporal Filtering for Video Grounding Inspired by the activity-silent and persistent activity mechanisms in human visual perception biology, we design a Unified Static and Dynamic Network (UniSDNet), to learn the semantic association between the video and text/audio queries in a cross-modal environment for efficient video grounding.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Unified Static and Dynamic Network: Efficient Temporal Filtering for Video Grounding Inspired by the activity-silent and persistent activity mechanisms in human visual perception biology, we design a Unified Static and Dynamic Network (UniSDNet), to learn the semantic association between the video and text/audio queries in a cross-modal environment for efficient video grounding.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Our UniSDNet achieves SOTA performance on three widely used datasets for NLVG, as well as three datasets for SLVG, e.g., reporting new records at 38.88% R@1,IoU@0.7 on ActivityNet Captions and 40.26% R@1,IoU@0.5 on TACoS.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Specifically, we construct a diffusely connected video clip graph on the basis of 2D sparse temporal masking to reflect the "short-term effect" relationship.

methods.name: Memory, Graph, or Structure Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: For static modeling, we devise a novel residual structure (ResMLP) to boost the global comprehensive interaction between the video segments and queries, achieving more effective semantic enhancement/supplement.
